segments.text: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

footnotes: unto…: or, to the hardness of their hearts, or, imagination

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

footnotes: submitted…: or, yielded feigned obedience: Heb. lied

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
